subtitle.en: Second and third year: leases, majors and side hustles
subtitle.zu: Unyaka wesibili nowesithathu: izivumelwano zokuqasha, izifundo eziyinhloko nemisebenzi eceleni

blurb.en: Old fees, moving off campus, choosing a major, part-time work, family expectations and burnout. About 6 minutes.
blurb.zu: Izimali ezindala, ukuthuthela ngaphandle kwekhampasi, ukukhetha isifundo esiyinhloko, umsebenzi wesikhashana, okulindelwe umndeni nokukhathala. Cishe imizuzu emi-6.

text.en: The registration system blocks you: there's an outstanding balance from last year. Classes start on Monday.
text.zu: Uhlelo lokubhalisa luyakuvimba: kunebhalansi engakakhokhwa yonyaka odlule. Izifundo ziqala ngoMsombuluko.

outcome.en: A week passes. You miss the first lectures and the block is still there.
outcome.zu: Kudlula isonto. Uphuthelwa yizifundo zokuqala futhi ukuvinjwa kusekhona.

outcome.en: A monthly arrangement you can afford, and the block is lifted the same day.
outcome.zu: Isivumelwano sanyanga zonke ongasikhokha, futhi ukuvinjwa kuyasuswa ngalolo suku.

tip.en: Fees offices would rather arrange a plan than lose a student. Ask early.
tip.zu: Amahhovisi ezimali angcono ukuhlela uhlelo kunokulahlekelwa ngumfundi. Buza kusenesikhathi.

outcome.en: The SRC helps you apply to a programme that clears part of historic student debt, and you're registered while it's processed.
outcome.zu: I-SRC ikusiza ufake isicelo ohlelweni olususa ingxenye yezikweletu ezindala zabafundi, futhi uyabhaliswa ngenkathi kusacutshungulwa.

text.en: You have to pick your electives for {course} by Friday. Your friends are all choosing the same two.
text.zu: Kufanele ukhethe izifundo ozikhethelayo ze-{course} ngoLwesihlanu. Abangane bakho bonke bakhetha ezimbili ezifanayo.

outcome.en: Same classes, same study group. You're not sure you love the work.
outcome.zu: Amakilasi afanayo, iqembu lokufunda elifanayo. Awuqiniseki ukuthi uwuthanda umsebenzi.

outcome.en: New classmates, but the work actually holds your attention.
outcome.zu: Abafunda nabo abasha, kodwa umsebenzi uyakuthakasela ngempela.

outcome.en: You see which electives lead to which jobs, and pick with your eyes open.
outcome.zu: Ubona ukuthi yiziphi izifundo ozikhethelayo eziholela kuyiphi imisebenzi, bese ukhetha ubona kahle.

title.en: Moving off campus: lease, deposit, housemates
title.zu: Ukuthuthela ngaphandle kwekhampasi: isivumelwano, idiphozithi, abahlala nawe

text.en: Three friends want to share a house near campus. The agent wants a signed lease and a R2 000 deposit, split four ways, by tomorrow. You have {money}.
text.zu: Abangane abathathu bafuna ukwabelana ngendlu eduze nekhampasi. I-ejenti ifuna isivumelwano esisayiniwe nedipozithi engu-R2 000, ihlukaniswe kane, kusasa. Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: The lease makes you liable for the whole house's water bill. The first one, R300, arrives with your R500 share of the deposit.
outcome.zu: Isivumelwano sikwenza ubhekane nesikweletu samanzi sendlu yonke. Esokuqala, u-R300, sifika nengxenye yakho yedipozithi engu-R500.

outcome.en: You spot the water-bill clause and get it changed before signing.
outcome.zu: Ubona isigaba sesikweletu samanzi bese usishintsha ngaphambi kokusayina.

outcome.en: A fourth-year spots the damp and the dodgy clause. You negotiate both.
outcome.zu: Umfundi wonyaka wesine ubona umswakama nesigaba esingathembekile. Nixoxisana ngakho kokubili.

tip.en: No senior to ask? A res mentor, the SRC or the accommodation office can look at a lease with you before you sign.
tip.zu: Akekho umfundi omdala ongambuza? Umeluleki we-res, i-SRC noma ihhovisi lezindawo zokuhlala bangabheka isivumelwano nawe ngaphambi kokusayina.

outcome.en: You tell your friends you're staying put this year. No deposit, no move, and you visit their house on weekends.
outcome.zu: Utshela abangane bakho ukuthi uzohlala lapho ukhona kulo nyaka. Ayikho idiphozithi, akukho ukuthutha, futhi ubavakashela ngezimpelasonto.

text.en: Second year is a step up: longer reports, more reading and less guidance. The study habits that got you through first year aren't keeping up.
text.zu: Unyaka wesibili uphakeme: imibiko emide, ukufunda okuningi nokuqondiswa okuncane. Imikhuba yokufunda ekudlulise onyakeni wokuqala ayisakwazi.

outcome.en: More hours, same methods. You're tired, and the marks barely move.
outcome.zu: Amahora amaningi, izindlela ezifanayo. Ukhathele, futhi amamaki awashintshi kangako.

outcome.en: Four of you meet twice a week and take turns explaining a topic. Teaching it is how you finally learn it.
outcome.zu: Nina abane nihlangana kabili ngesonto futhi nishintshana ngokuchaza isihloko. Ukusifundisa yikho okwenza ugcine usifundile.

tip.en: Post in the class group or ask your tutor to connect you. Most libraries have group study rooms you can book.
tip.zu: Bhala eqenjini lekilasi noma ucele umfundisi wakho akuxhumanise. Imitapo eminingi inamagumbi okufunda ngamaqembu ongawabhukha.

outcome.en: Three free workshops: time management, academic writing and study methods. Your next report takes half the time.
outcome.zu: Amasifundisane amathathu amahhala: ukuphatha isikhathi, ukubhala kwezemfundo nezindlela zokufunda. Umbiko wakho olandelayo uthatha ingxenye yesikhathi.

title.en: Your friends move ahead without you

text.en: Because of one repeated module, your friends are in third-year classes while you're still finishing second-year ones. {memory}
text.zu: Ngenxa yesifundo esisodwa esiphindiwe, abangane bakho basemakilasini onyaka wesithathu ngenkathi wena usaqeda awonyaka wesibili. {memory}

outcome.en: You stop going to the group's study sessions so nobody asks.
outcome.zu: Uyayeka ukuya emaseshini okufunda eqembu ukuze kungabikho obuzayo.

outcome.en: One of them repeated a module too. Nobody thinks less of you.
outcome.zu: Omunye wabo naye waphinda isifundo. Akekho okubukela phansi.

outcome.en: Your new classmates are keen and organised. You catch up together.
outcome.zu: Abafunda nawe abasha bayashisekela futhi bahlelekile. Nibamba ndawonye.

text.en: Your braiding, tutoring or design work is getting noticed, and people want to pay you for it.
text.zu: Umsebenzi wakho wokuluka izinwele, ukufundisa noma ukuklama uyaqashelwa, futhi abantu bafuna ukukukhokhela.

outcome.en: The money is good. Your evenings disappear.
outcome.zu: Imali inhle. Izikhathi zakho zakusihlwa ziyanyamalala.

outcome.en: Weekends only. A little extra money and your studies stay on track.
outcome.zu: Izimpelasonto kuphela. Imali encane eyengeziwe futhi izifundo zakho zihlala zisendleleni.

outcome.en: You keep a list of interested clients for the holidays.
outcome.zu: Ugcina uhlu lwamakhasimende anentshisekelo lwamaholide.

title.en: Home expects more as you get closer to earning
title.zu: Ekhaya balindele okwengeziwe njengoba usuzoqala ukuhola

text.en: Now that you're halfway through, home asks for {amount} a month. "You'll be earning soon anyway." You have {money}.
text.zu: Manje njengoba usuphakathi, ekhaya bacela u-{amount} ngenyanga. "Uzobe usuhola maduze noma kunjalo." Uno-{money}.

outcome.en: Home is proud and grateful. Your month gets very tight.
outcome.zu: Ekhaya baziqhenya futhi bayabonga. Inyanga yakho iba nzima kakhulu.

outcome.en: You agree on half, every month, on payday. Everyone knows what to expect.
outcome.zu: Nivumelana ngesigamu, nyanga zonke, ngosuku lokuholela. Wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi angalindelani.

tip.en: Decide upfront what share of your money you can send each month, and tell home when your money arrives so they can plan too.
tip.zu: Nquma kusenesikhathi ukuthi ingakanani ingxenye yemali yakho ongayithumela nyanga zonke, futhi utshele ekhaya uma imali yakho ifika ukuze nabo bahlele.

outcome.en: You show them your budget and when you'll graduate. It's a hard talk, and it helps.
outcome.zu: Ubakhombisa ibhajethi yakho nokuthi uzothweswa nini iziqu. Kuyingxoxo enzima, futhi iyasiza.

title.en: A chance to tutor or lead a society

text.en: Your lecturer asks if you'd tutor first-years, and your society needs a new treasurer.
text.zu: Umfundisi wakho ubuza ukuthi ungafundisa abafundi bonyaka wokuqala, futhi inhlangano yakho idinga umgcinimafa omusha.

events.research: High-impact practices: peer teaching and leadership

outcome.en: You keep your time for your own work.
outcome.zu: Ugcina isikhathi sakho somsebenzi wakho.

outcome.en: Teaching makes you understand your own subject better. You're busy.
outcome.zu: Ukufundisa kukwenza uqonde isifundo sakho kangcono. Umatasa.

outcome.en: One tutorial a week. It looks great on your CV.
outcome.zu: Ithuthorial eyodwa ngesonto. Kubukeka kahle ku-CV yakho.

text.en: Applications for vacation work open this week. You've never written a CV or spoken to a lecturer about careers.
text.zu: Izicelo zomsebenzi wamaholide zivulwa kuleli sonto. Awukaze ubhale i-CV noma ukhulume nomfundisi ngemisebenzi.

outcome.en: You'll try next year. Classmates come back with experience on their CVs.
outcome.zu: Uzozama ngonyaka ozayo. Abafunda nawe babuya nesipiliyoni kuma-CV abo.

outcome.en: Twelve applications on your own. A couple of replies come back.
outcome.zu: Izicelo eziyishumi nambili wedwa. Kubuya izimpendulo ezimbalwa.

tip.en: Vacancies are posted on the career services portal, at career fairs and on department notice boards.
tip.zu: Izikhala zomsebenzi zifakwa kuphothali yezinsizakalo zemisebenzi, emibukisweni yemisebenzi nasemabhodini ezaziso omnyango.

outcome.en: Career services fix your CV, and your lecturer writes a reference.
outcome.zu: Izinsizakalo zemisebenzi zilungisa i-CV yakho, futhi umfundisi wakho ubhala incwadi yokukweseka.

text.en: Classes, work, family and everything else. You're tired in a way sleep doesn't fix, and nothing feels interesting any more.
text.zu: Izifundo, umsebenzi, umndeni nakho konke okunye. Ukhathele ngendlela ukulala okungakulungisi, futhi akukho okusathakazelisa.

outcome.en: You get through the week, running on empty.
outcome.zu: Udlula isonto, amandla aphelile.

outcome.en: You drop one commitment and take a real weekend off. It helps more than you expected.
outcome.zu: Ushiya isibophezelo esisodwa futhi uthathe impelasonto yangempela yokuphumula. Kusiza kakhulu kunalokho obukulindele.

outcome.en: A counsellor helps you see the pattern and plan your load for next semester.
outcome.zu: Umeluleki ukusiza ubone iphethini futhi uhlele umthwalo wakho wesemesta elandelayo.

text.en: An email: you start in December. Real work experience, and money for next year.
text.zu: I-imeyili: uqala ngoDisemba. Isipiliyoni sangempela somsebenzi, nemali yonyaka ozayo.

text.en: Your name is on the Dean's List again. Your family shares it with everyone they know.
text.zu: Igama lakho lisohlwini lukaDini futhi. Umndeni wakho ukwabelana nawo wonke umuntu abamaziyo.

text.en: An email from your funder: your funding stops at the end of this year. You missed a pass requirement, or you've used the years it covers.
text.zu: I-imeyili evela kumxhasi wakho: uxhaso lwakho luphela ekupheleni kwalo nyaka. Awufinyelelanga isidingo sokuphasa, noma usebenzise iminyaka eluyikhavayo.

outcome.en: You carry it alone for weeks. Next year's registration is still coming.
outcome.zu: Ukuthwala wedwa amasonto. Ukubhalisa konyaka ozayo kusazofika.

outcome.en: You send your results, a motivation and proof of what happened. The funder agrees to review it.
outcome.zu: Uthumela imiphumela yakho, incwadi yokuzichaza nobufakazi balokho okwenzekile. Umxhasi uyavuma ukukubuyekeza.

tip.en: Appeal forms and deadlines are on your funder's portal. Attach your results, a short explanation and any proof.
tip.zu: Amafomu ezikhalazo nemingcele yesikhathi akuphothali yomxhasi wakho. Namathisela imiphumela yakho, incazelo emfushane nanoma yibuphi ubufakazi.

label.en: Ask financial aid what else exists

outcome.en: Financial aid helps you appeal, and lists what the university itself offers: its own bursaries, hardship funds and payment plans.
outcome.zu: Abosizo lwezimali bakusiza ufake isikhalazo, futhi babala lokho okunikezwa yinyuvesi uqobo: imifundaze yayo, izimali zosizo nezinhlelo zokukhokha.

tip.en: Funding problems are not only a first-year thing. The financial aid office helps senior students too, and faculties often have bursaries for second and third years.
tip.zu: Izinkinga zoxhaso akuzona ezonyaka wokuqala kuphela. Ihhovisi losizo lwezimali lisiza nabafundi abadala, futhi amafakhalthi avame ukuba nemifundaze yonyaka wesibili nowesithathu.

text.en: Some degrees require vacation work as part of a module. Do you know if yours does?
text.zu: Ezinye iziqu zidinga umsebenzi wamaholide njengengxenye yesifundo. Uyazi ukuthi ezakho ziyawudinga?

outcome.en: Yours needs it before final year. {svc_careers}, and your faculty's placement office if it has one, help students find a place.
outcome.zu: Ezakho ziyawudinga ngaphambi konyaka wokugcina. {svc_careers}, nehhovisi lefakhalthi yakho lokubeka abafundi uma likhona, kusiza abafundi bathole indawo.

outcome.en: Placements fill early. When you are ready, start with {svc_careers} or your faculty office.
outcome.zu: Izindawo zigcwala kusenesikhathi. Uma usulungile, qala nge-{svc_careers} noma ihhovisi lefakhalthi yakho.

text.en: Do you know how many modules you must pass this year to be allowed to continue?
text.zu: Uyazi ukuthi zingaki izifundo okufanele uziphase kulo nyaka ukuze uvunyelwe ukuqhubeka?

outcome.en: The faculty handbook gives the credits you must pass each year to avoid academic exclusion. Now you know where your line is.
outcome.zu: Incwadi yefakhalthi inikeza amakhredithi okufanele uwaphase unyaka ngamunye ukuze ugweme ukukhishwa. Manje uyazi ukuthi umugqa wakho ukuphi.

outcome.en: Fair enough. It is under "progression" or "exclusion rules" on the university website, or ask your faculty office.
outcome.zu: Kulungile. Kungaphansi kwe-"progression" noma "exclusion rules" kuwebhusayithi yenyuvesi, noma ubuze ehhovisi lefakhalthi yakho.
